prompt: The attached image is a 216x216 px frame from an animated GIF. Rebuild the scene in 3D with three.js. Task (3D, static): write an HTML page that builds the scene from code and renders it so that the view from your reference camera reproduces the image as faithfully as you can: characters, poses, facial expressions, hands, props, background, and colors. A later step will animate your scene, so structure it in named groups. For this static step, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one
html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Laughing character</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;width:216px;height:216px;overflow:hidden}
canvas{display:block;width:216px;height:216px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xf4f6f4);
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({preserveDrawingBuffer:true});
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(216,216);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const ref = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-2.7,2.7,2.7,-2.7,0.1,40);
ref.position.set(0,0,12);
ref.lookAt(0,0,0);

function group(name,parent,x=0,y=0,z=0){
  const part = new THREE.Group();
  part.name=name;
  part.position.set(x,y,z);
  parent.add(part);
  return part;
}

function matte(color, grain=0){
  const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color,roughness:0.91});
  if(grain){
    material.onBeforeCompile = shader => {
      shader.vertexShader = shader.vertexShader
        .replace('#include <common>','#include <common>\nvarying vec3 fleckPosition;')
        .replace('#include <begin_vertex>','#include <begin_vertex>\nfleckPosition=position;');
      shader.fragmentShader = shader.fragmentShader
        .replace('#include <common>','#include <common>\nvarying vec3 fleckPosition;')
        .replace('#include <color_fragment>',`
          #include <color_fragment>
          vec3 cell=floor(fleckPosition*92.0);
          float fleck=fract(sin(dot(cell,vec3(31.1,71.7,17.9)))*43758.5453);
          diffuseColor.rgb *= 1.0 + (fleck-0.5)*${grain.toFixed(3)};
        `);
    };
    material.customProgramCacheKey = () => 'fleck-'+grain;
  }
  return material;
}

const skin=matte(0xdca82f,0.15);
const headSkin=matte(0xe1b439,0.14);
const shoulderSkin=matte(0xdfac31,0.14);
const belly=matte(0xcba578,0.12);
const lip=matte(0x9e6c28);
const innerLip=matte(0x502d19);
const dark=matte(0x10090a);
const lid=matte(0x332218);
const teeth=matte(0xf6eacf);
const gum=matte(0x562a22);
const handMat=matte(0x514739,0.12);
const fingerMat=matte(0x574c3c,0.12);

function mesh(name,parent,geometry,material){
  const object=new THREE.Mesh(geometry,material);
  object.name=name;
  parent.add(object);
  return object;
}

const sphere=new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,48,32);
function ellipsoid(name,parent,material,position,scale){
  const object=mesh(name,parent,sphere,material);
  object.position.set(...position);
  object.scale.set(...scale);
  return object;
}

function tube(name,parent,material,stations){
  const path=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(stations.map(p=>new THREE.Vector3(...p.slice(0,3))));
  const profile=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(stations.map((p,i)=>new THREE.Vector3(p[3],p[4],i)));
  const points=[],indices=[];
  const rows=56,sides=40;
  const depth=new THREE.Vector3(0,0,1);
  for(let i=0;i<=rows;i++){
    const t=i/rows;
    const c=path.getPoint(t), d=path.getTangent(t);
    const across=new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(d,depth).normalize();
    const front=new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(across,d).normalize();
    const size=profile.getPoint(t);
    for(let j=0;j<sides;j++){
      const angle=j/sides*Math.PI*2;
      const p=c.clone().addScaledVector(across,Math.max(.002,size.x)*Math.cos(angle))
        .addScaledVector(front,Math.max(.002,size.y)*Math.sin(angle));
      points.push(p.x,p.y,p.z);
      if(i<rows){
        const a=i*sides+j,b=i*sides+(j+1)%sides;
        indices.push(a,a+sides,b,b,a+sides,b+sides);
      }
    }
  }
  for(let j=1;j<sides-1;j++){
    indices.push(0,j,j+1,rows*sides,rows*sides+j+1,rows*sides+j);
  }
  const geometry=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geometry.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(points,3));
  geometry.setIndex(indices);
  geometry.computeVertexNormals();
  return mesh(name,parent,geometry,material);
}

function line(name,parent,material,points,radius){
  const curve=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points.map(p=>new THREE.Vector3(...p)));
  return mesh(name,parent,new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve,36,radius,10,false),material);
}

function outline(start,segments){
  const shape=new THREE.Shape();
  shape.moveTo(...start);
  for(const segment of segments) shape.bezierCurveTo(...segment);
  return shape.getPoints(10).slice(0,-1);
}

function patch(name,parent,material,border,center,surface){
  const positions=[],indices=[];
  const n=border.length,rings=13;
  const push=(x,y)=>positions.push(x,y,surface(x,y));
  push(...center);
  for(let i=1;i<=rings;i++){
    const r=i/rings;
    for(const p of border) push(THREE.MathUtils.lerp(center[0],p.x,r),THREE.MathUtils.lerp(center[1],p.y,r));
  }
  const ccw=THREE.ShapeUtils.isClockWise(border)===false;
  function tri(a,b,c){if(ccw)indices.push(a,b,c);else indices.push(a,c,b);}
  for(let j=0;j<n;j++){
    const next=(j+1)%n;
    tri(0,1+j,1+next);
    for(let i=1;i<rings;i++){
      const a=1+(i-1)*n+j,b=1+(i-1)*n+next;
      tri(a,a+n,b);
      tri(b,a+n,b+n);
    }
  }
  const geometry=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geometry.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions,3));
  geometry.setIndex(indices);
  geometry.computeVertexNormals();
  return mesh(name,parent,geometry,material);
}

const character=group('character-laughing',scene);
const legs=group('legs',character);
tube('thigh-and-shin',group('leg-image-left',legs,-.38,-1.25,-.05),skin,[
  [0,.47,0,.015,.015],[0,.16,0,.49,.50],[.03,-.37,.04,.38,.41],
  [.21,-.93,.13,.28,.33],[.35,-1.43,.12,.20,.26],[.34,-1.82,.20,.04,.06]
]);
tube('thigh-and-shin',group('leg-image-right',legs,.95,-1.33,-.19),skin,[
  [0,.51,0,.02,.02],[.09,.18,0,.55,.56],[.16,-.33,.08,.49,.48],
  [.24,-.84,.05,.33,.37],[.38,-1.32,.04,.25,.28],[.36,-1.83,.08,.04,.05]
]);

const trunk=group('torso',character,.40,-.11,-.02);
trunk.rotation.z=.10;
const torsoRadius=[1.10,1.66,.78];
ellipsoid('body',trunk,skin,[0,0,0],torsoRadius);
const bellyOutline=outline([-.91,.05],[
  [-.65,.16,-.19,.15,.22,-.01],[.59,-.14,.81,-.31,.83,-.57],
  [.80,-.91,.49,-1.34,.08,-1.42],[-.34,-1.48,-.66,-1.22,-.82,-.86],
  [-.94,-.57,-.98,-.16,-.91,.05]
]);
patch('cream-belly',trunk,belly,bellyOutline,[-.08,-.64],
  (x,y)=>.78*Math.sqrt(Math.max(.015,1-(x/1.10)**2-(y/1.66)**2))+.011);

const farArm=group('arm-image-left',character,-.64,1.02,0);
tube('upper-arm-and-forearm',farArm,skin,[
  [.24,.46,-.06,.02,.02],[.03,.20,.01,.39,.43],[-.08,-.15,.04,.35,.39],
  [-.13,-.64,.03,.27,.32],[-.11,-1.16,.04,.22,.27],
  [-.01,-1.74,.12,.19,.22],[.11,-2.29,.27,.15,.17],[.10,-2.76,.47,.10,.11]
]);

const nearArm=group('arm-image-right',character,1.11,1.00,.05);
tube('upper-arm-and-forearm',nearArm,shoulderSkin,[
  [-.13,.43,-.13,.03,.03],[.05,.13,-.05,.38,.45],[.34,-.21,.00,.48,.53],
  [.52,-.63,.04,.57,.57],[.50,-1.13,.10,.57,.52],
  [.38,-1.54,.25,.46,.43],[.23,-1.91,.47,.34,.33],
  [.14,-2.40,.65,.26,.25],[.10,-2.78,.72,.16,.17]
]);

function hand(name,parent,x,y,z,scale,rotation,mirror){
  const part=group(name,parent,x,y,z);
  part.scale.set(scale*mirror,scale,scale);
  part.rotation.z=rotation;
  ellipsoid('palm',part,handMat,[0,-.095,.012],[.195,.219,.115]);
  const fingers=[
    [-.148,-.55,-.274,-.42],
    [-.057,-.65,-.127,-.62],
    [.041,-.69,.049,-.68],
    [.126,-.61,.201,-.60],
    [.174,-.46,.302,-.44]
  ];
  for(let i=0;i<fingers.length;i++){
    const [base,endY,endX,bendY]=fingers[i];
    const digit=group(i===0?'thumb':'finger-'+i,part,base,-.15,.025);
    const width=i===0?.068:.056;
    tube('digit',digit,fingerMat,[
      [0,.065,-.015,.02,.02],[0,0,0,width,.068],
      [(endX-base)*.54,bendY*.62+.10,.035,width*.95,.053],
      [endX-base,endY+.18,.024,width*.79,.047],
      [endX-base,endY+.14,.004,.015,.019]
    ]);
  }
}
hand('hand-image-left',farArm,.12,-2.76,.48,.89,-.14,1);
hand('hand-image-right',nearArm,.10,-2.77,.74,1.09,.10,1);

const head=group('head',character,.276,1.54,.39);
head.rotation.z=-.285;
const hr=[.737,.89,.638];
ellipsoid('head-volume',head,headSkin,[0,0,0],hr);
const faceZ=(x,y)=>hr[2]*Math.sqrt(Math.max(.06,1-(x/hr[0])**2-(y/hr[1])**2));
const face=group('face',head);
const eyes=group('eyes',face);
for(const side of [-1,1]){
  const eye=group(side<0?'eye-image-left':'eye-image-right',eyes);
  const cx=side*.386;
  const cy=side<0?.459:.493;
  const bounds=outline([cx-.156,cy-.050],[
    [cx-.103,cy+.096,cx+.045,cy+.12,cx+.153,cy+.009],
    [cx+.066,cy+.043,cx-.046,cy+.062,cx-.156,cy-.050]
  ]);
  patch('closed-lid',eye,lid,bounds,[cx,cy+.043],(x,y)=>faceZ(x,y)+.013);
}

const mouth=group('mouth',face);
const mouthOutline=outline([-.467,.192],[
  [-.293,.306,.272,.300,.441,.183],
  [.517,.080,.434,-.237,.323,-.409],
  [.210,-.612,.065,-.727,-.086,-.717],
  [-.311,-.715,-.426,-.539,-.475,-.321],
  [-.527,-.106,-.518,.079,-.467,.192]
]);
const mouthCenter=[-.022,-.213];
patch('outer-lip',mouth,lip,mouthOutline,mouthCenter,(x,y)=>faceZ(x,y)+.013);
function scaleBorder(border,scale){
  return border.map(p=>new THREE.Vector2(
    mouthCenter[0]+(p.x-mouthCenter[0])*scale,
    mouthCenter[1]+(p.y-mouthCenter[1])*scale
  ));
}
patch('inner-lip',mouth,innerLip,scaleBorder(mouthOutline,.934),mouthCenter,(x,y)=>faceZ(x,y)+.018);
patch('mouth-cavity',mouth,dark,scaleBorder(mouthOutline,.866),mouthCenter,(x,y)=>faceZ(x,y)+.024);
const tongueOutline=outline([-.222,-.548],[
  [-.136,-.507,.016,-.522,.107,-.555],
  [.069,-.601,-.031,-.639,-.108,-.629],
  [-.162,-.622,-.222,-.587,-.222,-.548]
]);
patch('tongue-in-shadow',mouth,gum,tongueOutline,[-.066,-.580],(x,y)=>faceZ(x,y)+.032);

const upper=group('upper-teeth',mouth);
const lower=group('lower-teeth',mouth);
const topCurve=[[-.353,.127],[-.275,.158],[-.195,.174],[-.110,.179],[-.025,.179],[.060,.176],[.146,.167],[.229,.152],[.308,.133],[.365,.107]];
topCurve.forEach(([x,y],i)=>{
  const tooth=ellipsoid('tooth-'+(i+1),upper,teeth,[x,y,faceZ(x,y)+.042],
    [i===0||i===9?.040:.051,i===0||i===9?.079:.056,.034]);
  tooth.rotation.z=(i-4.5)*.071;
});
const bottomCurve=[[-.328,-.448],[-.293,-.509],[-.245,-.553],[-.190,-.583],[-.130,-.598],[-.070,-.600],[-.010,-.587],[.048,-.563],[.102,-.527],[.152,-.484]];
bottomCurve.forEach(([x,y],i)=>{
  const tooth=ellipsoid('tooth-'+(i+1),lower,teeth,[x,y,faceZ(x,y)+.043],
    [.034,i===0||i===9?.063:.031,.024]);
  tooth.rotation.z=(i-4.5)*-.142;
});

scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xf9faff,0xcab092,1.76));
function light(color,intensity,x,y,z){
  const source=new THREE.DirectionalLight(color,intensity);
  source.position.set(x,y,z);
  scene.add(source);
}
light(0xfff3d2,1.57,-3,6,3.8);
light(0xffefd5,.42,4,2,-4);
light(0xdce9ff,.25,1,-3,4);

const backdrop=new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  vertexShader:`
    varying vec2 p;
    void main(){
      p=uv;
      gl_Position=projectionMatrix*modelViewMatrix*vec4(position,1.0);
    }
  `,
  fragmentShader:`
    varying vec2 p;
    float hash(vec2 q){return fract(sin(dot(q,vec2(127.1,311.7)))*43758.5453);}
    float noise(vec2 q){
      vec2 i=floor(q),f=fract(q);
      f=f*f*(3.0-2.0*f);
      return mix(mix(hash(i),hash(i+vec2(1,0)),f.x),
                 mix(hash(i+vec2(0,1)),hash(i+vec2(1,1)),f.x),f.y);
    }
    void main(){
      float haze=noise(p*6.4)+.35*noise(p*16.0);
      float floorTone=1.0-smoothstep(-.035,.25,p.y+.028*haze);
      float shadow=exp(-pow((p.x-.65)*3.1,2.0)-pow((p.y+.025)*9.0,2.0));
      float fibers=(noise(p*145.0)-.5)*.018;
      vec3 paper=vec3(.957,.966,.961)+(haze-.68)*.044+fibers;
      paper-=vec3(.095,.092,.092)*floorTone;
      paper-=vec3(.105,.10,.097)*shadow;
      gl_FragColor=vec4(paper,1.0);
    }
  `,
  depthWrite:false
});
const background=mesh('studio-background',scene,new THREE.PlaneGeometry(5.4,5.4),backdrop);
background.position.z=-5;
background.renderOrder=-10;

function render(t){
  renderer.render(scene,ref);
}
render(0);
window.nwb={scene,renderer,cameras:{ref},characters:[character],render,ready:true};
</script>
</body>
</html>
